**[1.8 - 1.21.x]** 🌍 **Welcome to ❖ Mineland Network ❖ **🌍
A server where every game mode is a whole new universe, and you are the main character. Thousands of players are already here. Join the action!

⏩ **IP: mod.mineland.net**

🌲**Survival 1.16 │The Shadow of Herobrine**
A true adventure for those who crave a deep, immersive atmosphere. Build powerful alliances, collect the rarest armor sets, and always stay on your guard. Herobrine isn’t just a myth for newbies here — he is a real part of this world. Survival that keeps you on the edge of your seat every single minute!

⚔️ **BedWars & SkyWars│Pure Esports**
Zero RNG, purely skill-based combat. We’ve built the perfect arena for dynamic fights: flawless balance, crisp hit registration, and fast-paced matches. Prove that your micro-control, reaction time, and timings are better than the rest.

💎 **SkyBlock │The Art of Economy**
Designed for players who love managing financial flows and thinking strategically. Start with a tiny island, carefully track rare resources, and build a flawless economic empire. Choose the hardcore Classic mode for long-term investments, or jump into version 1.16 for a fast and aggressive market.

💬 **A community that never sleeps!**
Find teammates, join epic events, and just enjoy the vibe 24/7.
Discord: https://mineland.net/discord/en
Forum: https://forum.mineland.net

⏩ Connect right now: mod.mineland.net
